records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Harbor Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Next step for Harbor Logistics in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for getting Harbor Logistics started in Wrenfield — you've created a first project and sent an invite, which is the hardest part.

If it's useful, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and projects are the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. Since you're on the Team plan, there are a few things worth setting up early too.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever your team needs next and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Nadia
